notes_for_us: The genre file insists an animal sim has no town and is wilderness plus dens, but this prompt is a human walking a pet. Pet Care assumes a settlement, Animal Sim assumes you are the animal, and the walker-with-companion case falls between two presets.

Avatar or pet customisation has no option anywhere, despite this genre being called Avatar Sim. `stage-runway` is a shape, so a game that only needs a grooming station or a wardrobe corner in an otherwise ordinary map has nowhere to put it.

notes_for_us: A queue pad — a marked box you stand in to join a match size — is one of the most common lobby features on Roblox and no option covers it. `social-hub` holds the lobby but says nothing about the boxes, so the actual request ended up as free text with no route.

Sports emits `trigger-bounds`, `startpoint-play` and `trigger-scoring` as `both`, which puts three identical concepts in both streams. The field rules say to trim to the visible half and the functional half, but for an invisible scoring plane there is no visible half, and the duplicate entries are noise.

Almost everything in this prompt is platform and control detail. Triage handled it, but it is worth noting that the layout-bearing content — pitch, goals, crowds, lobby boxes — is four items out of maybe twenty.
